newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa stocks finish at record highs, await data.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa stocks finish at record highs, await data.

text.p: South African industrial shares finished at record highs, as players anticipated that positive money supply and private sector credit figures would point to a reduction in the country's high interest rates.
The main feature of the day was the demerger of gold mining firm Gencor and the seperate listing of its base metals arm Billiton Plc.
Gold shares finished strong, boosted by a firmer bullion price which has been holding around the $326 per ounce level.
The industrial index gained 71.5 points to a record 9,125.9 points, lifting the all-share index up 46.8 points to a record 7,490.8 points. Gold shares rose 21.0 points to 990.8 points
